research_rationale:
EO:11642 (signed 1972-02-01; 37 FR 2565 (Federal Register of February 3, 1972)) is a single-command order. The order exempts A. Everette MacIntyre, a member of the Federal Trade Commission, from compulsory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5, United States Code, until February 28, 1973. The order recites that on November 16, 1970 the President issued Executive Order No. 11568 exempting him until February 29, 1972, and states that the public interest requires that Mr. MacIntyre be further exempted. Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing in jobs/fr-originals; its number, date and subject agree with the census register. Inventory: I confirm the dossier's one clause, which carries the recitals and the sole operative sentence; the text holds no other command, condition or proviso. The exemption ends by its own terms on 1973-02-28: the order's end date is quoted from the held text as "until February 28, 1973", recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, that it ends when February 28, 1973 begins, is the alternative a reviewer should see (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on until-dates). A later event: Executive Order 11704 (signed 1973-02-28; 38 FR 5619) recites this order and exempts the same person again, as it says, until "February 28,1974"; it is a new grant that takes over on the day this exemption ends and does not revoke, shorten or amend this order. Whether MacIntyre left office before the stated date is in no held source and is not asserted; the stated date is the latest day the exemption could operate. Searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes (all complete, none with a coverage warning): the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, citations of the order by number in statute text and notes; edition current through 2026-10-09) recorded 0 hits; the eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML recorded 0 hits; the Federal Register catalog disposition-note search (1937 onward) recorded 1 hits for this order. I also searched every held order text (the Cruden held-text search, 33118 readable files) for the order's number; the only held texts that cite it are its own Federal Register printing and, for EO 11642, EO 11704 and the earlier EO 11568, which recite it or its person. A held-text search of the person's name finds only that person's own exemption orders (EO 11568, EO 11642 and EO 11704) and unrelated matches.
